rules: Stepping onto a trap tile triggers it: the player (unless levitating) and every non-flying creature that steps there (1.7 stepEnt). Known traps are not avoided by creatures; travel and auto-explore avoid known traps unless the trap is the goal.
Triggering marks the trap found (except spikes). Web, Alarm and Pit are removed after one trigger; the rest stay armed.
A creature killed by a trap out of your sight dies unnamed.

Another creature springing a trap: logged by name if you can see the trap tile; else "You hear a trap spring <direction>." (alarm: "You hear an alarm bell ring <direction>.") within earshot (12 tiles of sound falloff), else nothing. Directions are 8-way compass, screen up is north.

There is no disarm action in 1.7. Ways to clear traps: Tide amulet trips every trap in the room (empty tiles: marked found and removed; alarms wake sleepers within 10), Seeking amulet reveals all within 16, Keen Eyes ring, Search, the Lightless room solution.
Cursed amulet backfire triggers a random one of dart, fire, frost, spark, gas, web, alarm at the wearer, without placing a trap.

rule-common.ruling: ruled 2026-10-15: every trap is found when it fires; levitating or flying bodies never trigger floor traps; Stone Skin and Earth 3 ignore spikes for any body

rule-player-damage-cap.does: Dart and spark damage to the player: at least 2 and at most 25% of max HP (rounded). Fire, frost, spikes, heavy bite are not capped.

rule-placement.ruling: ruled 2026-10-15: never in pocket rooms; placed until the target count or no legal cell

passive.chancePct: 8 + 3 x max(0, Agility - 10) + 12 if Scoundrel + min(0, Keen Eyes value), never below 0; x 0.2 for traps placed on purpose (trap room, bone gauntlet, goblin mine, puzzle)
passive.limit: at most one trap found per action; traps are checked in placement order

keenEyes.chancePct: the ring value as a percent, per visible unfound trap, every action, no range limit, no cap per action
keenEyes.secretDoors: half the ring chance per visible hidden door: "Your ring tingles: a hidden door." sfx door-secret

rule-spotting.ruling: ruled 2026-10-15: one passive roll per visible unfound trap per game turn, base + Agility + Scoundrel + trap-spot stat (Keen Eyes adds), sight range, x0.2 for placed traps, no cap

rule-search.chancePct: (40 + 2 x max(0, Agility - 10) + Keen Eyes value + 20 x earlier searches from this same tile) x 0.5 while resting
rule-search.hint: a hidden door adjacent (8-way) to an uneven-stone tell, when the searcher also stands next to a tell, is always found
rule-search.each: every hidden door and unfound trap within 2 (Chebyshev) rolls separately

logs.none: You search carefully[ again] and find nothing new.

rule-search.bumpSecret: walking into a hidden door: found if a tell is orthogonally beside it, else 25%; costs an action only when found ("You find a hidden door!")
